players.bio: Benjamin Peter Waine is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Port Vale, and the New Zealand national team.

George William Byers (born 29 May 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Port Vale. He is also a vice-captain. Born in England to Scottish parents, he has represented Scotland up to under-17 level.
Jackson William Smith (born 14 October 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Port Vale.

Jon Edmund Alexander Brady (born 14 January 1975) is an Australian soccer coach and former player who is the manager of EFL League Two club Port Vale. Brady was a youth player with Adamstown Rosebud when he was spotted by English club Brentford. He went on to spend time with Swansea City and Wycombe Wanderers, though it was at Norwegian club Mjølner where he made his senior debut in 1994.

Keyrol Alexis Figueroa Norales (born 31 August 2006) is a Honduran professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Port Vale, on loan from Premier League club Liverpool, and the Honduras national team. He is the son of former Honduras international Maynor Figueroa.

Liam Spencer Gordon (born 15 May 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Port Vale. Born in England, he represents the Guyana national team. Club career Gordon was born in the London Borough of Croydon and played for the youth teams of Fulham and AFC Wimbledon when he was a youngster and subsequently joined Carshalton Athletic.

Matthew Craig is a 23-year-old professional footballer who recently signed a permanent three-year contract with EFL League Two club Port Vale. Craig and his older identical twin brother Michael were born 2 minutes apart on 16 March 2003.
Modou Lamin Faal (born 11 February 2003) is a Gambian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Port Vale F.C., on loan from EFL Championship club Wrexham.

Rhys Anthony Walters is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Port Vale. He has previously played on loan at Leek Town. He was promoted out of League Two with Port Vale at the end of the 2024–25 season.

Ryan Mark Croasdale (born 26 September 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Port Vale. Club career Croasdale joined Preston North End in 2003 and made his first-team debut at the age of 19 in a Football League Trophy tie against Oldham Athletic, featuring for 45 mins in the 2–0 defeat.

Tyreece Tyson Nesbett Simpson (born 7 February 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Port Vale. Simpson joined the Ipswich Town academy in 2018, signing a 2-year scholarship.
